name: Necromancy (Mortuus Path) — 2 Intermediate — Resume the Coil

system.description: Spend a Willpower Trait and make a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty of 10 minus the target's Morality Traits to rouse a torporous Cainite. Touch is required if used on another individual; an additional Willpower Trait is required if awakening yourself. A vampire who entered torpor from blood loss awakens with one Blood Trait and will not hunger-frenzy for the first hour.
